question: What will be the average US 30-year Fixed-Rate Mortgage on December 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Freddie PMMS 30y was 7.28% on Nov 19, 2026 (7.11 prior week); Oct-Nov range 7.11-7.40. MND daily 7.32% on Nov 24 (2-week low), 10y ~4.90% after falling back below 5%. A Dec 8-9 25bp Fed hike is ~96% priced, so limited incremental impact; tech-stock turmoil is supporting bonds while hawkish Fed/Fannie upward revisions push the other way. Kalshi weekly market (search snippet, unverified) ~51% above 7.27% for this week's print, implying a start near 7.25-7.27. No market found on Polymarket/Manifold/bookmakers; I could not load Kalshi's pages, and the Kalshi contracts are weekly prints or the annual peak, not a contract for the Dec 31 reading itself. Random-walk from ~7.26 with ~20bp 5-week SD; out-of-range moves (>75bp) deemed negligible.
